card.name: Words just before a number or noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, who, must, for) and the blank spot before a number, in the middle of a phrase. The next word is often a time, a figure or a noun that completes the phrase.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The blank position right before a number such as hours or a date.
modes.example: preferably within<< >>48 hours after onset of signs and

modes.label: Linking word mid-phrase
modes.description: Words like of, who, must or for that lead into the noun or verb that finishes the phrase.

modes.label: of after a noun
modes.description: The word of after a noun such as periods or restoration.
modes.example: lack of employment for such long periods<< of>> time.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly favors words about progress and weakly disfavors words about loss or suffering.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words or gaps just before a number or noun, and has no single topic.
